about: Text values the publish tool's settings writer writes, as it writes them. A reader that follows YAML 1.1 (Obsidian, PyYAML, js-yaml) reads an unquoted 12:30 as the number 750 and an unquoted yes as true, so the writer quotes those. A lone y or n is the deliberate exception: only the `yaml` package in 1.1 mode reads it as a boolean (Obsidian, PyYAML and js-yaml do not), so it stays bare and the 1.1 check skips it (only_yaml_package_1_1_differs). Both sides read `written` back as `value`: tools/publish/test/yaml-shared-cases.test.js (the writer, and the yaml package in both 1.2 and 1.1 mode) and tests/test_yaml_shared_cases.py (vaultlib's frontmatter reader).
